name: Kobayashi Shou
source: Shou is [url=https://vndb.org/c63689]Takuya[/url]'s neighbour that has a lethargic attitude towards studying. He is a kind of kid that likes to play RPG games on his handheld console all day long. Due to that, his studying problems became so grave that his father had to employ a private tutor for him in order to motivate him to study. [spoiler]The [url=https://vndb.org/c63690]new tutor[/url]'s bound to have some trouble with him for sure.[/spoiler]
